newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Heavy in $200 mln India power plant deal.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Heavy in $200 mln India power plant deal.

text.p: Hyundai Heavy Industries Co, a unit of South Korea's Hyundai Group, said on Wednesday it had won a $200 million turn-key order from an Indian company to build a diesel-fueled power plant.
The Indian company, GMR Corp, gave the order to build the 200-megawatt plant in Madras, Tamil Nadu, a Hyundai statement said.
Hyundai claimed the plant would be the world's largest diesel-fueled unit.
Construction will start in December for completion by around the end of 1998, the statement said.
Hyundai Heavy is South Korea's largest shipbuilding company and also makes machinery and industrial structures.
